note: These cases describe what a reviewer should look for. They are not model-run results.

cases.input: Sam: I will send the revised brief to Jo by Friday. Decision: use the short intake form.
cases.authoredExpectation: One action row: send revised brief; owner Sam; due Friday; source reference includes Sam and the sentence. The decision is not an action row.
